entities.summary: Kornelia Kashiimbindjola Shilunga is a Namibian politician who was a member of the National Assembly from 2015 to 21 March 2025. She served as the Deputy Minister of Mines and Energy and the first woman Deputy Minister at the Ministry until 22 March 2025.
